FFmpeg decoder

The imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 Windows wheel contains the FFmpeg 7.1 essentials
build from Gyan Doshi. The executable reports GPL version 3 or later.
COPYING.GPLv3 contains the GPL version 3 license.

FFmpeg build and source information:
https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/7.1
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/b08d7969c5

The imageio-ffmpeg Python package is BSD-2-Clause licensed. Its LICENSE file
is included in packaged builds in this folder.

Before distributing a build, verify the GPL requirements for the FFmpeg
binary and all of its linked libraries, including complete corresponding
source. These notices do not establish that distribution requirements are met.
